# Claude Code context

Read [AGENT_CONTEXT.md](AGENT_CONTEXT.md) first — it holds what is true for
every tool — and [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) for the authority. This file carries
only what is specific to Claude Code in this repository.

## Your surface

`.claude/` is rendered in **pointer** mode: each file names its canonical body under `agentic/` and restates none of it, so what you read there is an address and never the policy itself. Act on the canonical body, not on the pointer.

| Kind | Where | Files |
| --- | --- | --- |
| rules | `.claude/rules/*.md` | 23 |
| skills | `.claude/skills/*.md` | 29 |
| workflows | `.claude/commands/*.md` | 22 |

## What that means when you work here

- `CLAUDE.md` at the root is loaded automatically. It is itself a pointer to `AGENTS.md`, so the authority chain has one root and no tool-specific fork.
- A rule under `.claude/rules/` is not auto-attached by path. Open the rules whose scope covers the files you are touching; the scope is stated in the canonical body, not in the pointer.
- A file under `.claude/skills/` is listed as a skill, but its body is a pointer — read `agentic/skills/<id>/SKILL.md` before running the procedure, because the front-matter that declares the operation's mode lives there.
- A file under `.claude/commands/` backs the `/<name>` slash command; the workflow body it names is canonical under `agentic/workflows/`.

## MCP

- Config path for this surface: `~/.claude.json` — never committed.
- Committed example: none — there is nothing tool-specific to template.
- Servers this surface may not install without an explicit human decision: none are marked `user_confirmed` here.
- Nothing is installed automatically. `agentic/mcp_registry.yaml` declares each server's ceiling risk mode, and adding one is a supply-chain decision made on the repository's behalf.

## The mode contract

Every operation carries AUTO, CONSULT or STOP — the three are defined in
[CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md#auto-consult-stop) and mapped operation by
operation in [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md#agent-behavior-protocol). The mode is a
property of the operation, not of the tool running it and not of your
confidence in it: the same procedure carries the same mode here as on every
other surface, and a surface that appears to weaken one has drifted.

## Editing

Never edit a file under `.claude/`, and never edit this file. Edit the
canonical body under `agentic/`, then:

```bash
python scripts/sync_agentic_adapters.py
python scripts/validate_agentic_surface.py --strict
```
